reason: My competitor just opened with a slick new look and mine feels dated next to it. A free first look costs me nothing but a comment, so I would take it to see what they would change.
objection: A pretty brand does not fill a hotel or a restaurant table. I have paid designers before and the work looked good but the phone did not ring any more.
would_change_my_mind: Before and after examples from a business like mine that show more bookings or enquiries after the rebrand, not just nicer pictures.
